fields.summary: Autonomous plan run, no owner. The planner found that session.Stalled (internal/session/status.go) flags only hook-status working sessions silent over 20 minutes, so a run-step session idle at its prompt without `rhiza session done` (for example after ending its turn while a background shell ran) is never flagged, and nudging exists only as the inbox app's manual n. The planner asked what should count as stalled and who nudges; the arbiter answered with Decision idle-run-session-stalls: idle or working unchanged for over 20 minutes without done is stalled (not when waiting on the arbiter, usage-paused, blocked or exited); the inbox lists it as today; an autonomous daemon nudges it once per stall, telling it to check any background shell's result and carry on or say done. The change set serves milestone-25 like the other fixes, and plans two leaves: the widened stall rule in run status and the inbox, and the daemon's one-time nudge. The landed capabilities run-status-stalled-session and inbox-stalled-items get acceptance updated so they no longer say idle sessions never stall.
fields.title: Idle run sessions stall: autonomous plan of change set 01M6N9AF
